findings.location: Statement clause (a), sentence beginning “consequently T_l extends uniquely to a linear isometry”
findings.evidence: T_l is defined on compactly supported L² sources, but clause (a) says it extends to a map whose domain is the positive spectral subspace; the compact-source domain is not a subset of that subspace. The proof instead extends T_l to a contraction on all of L² and restricts it to the positive spectral subspace. Define the induced map on the projected compact-source core, or state T_l = widehat T_l E_{A_l}((0,∞)), to make the extension precise. The assigned two-body consumer uses this supplier’s spectral representation.
